name: kaneo
tagline: Open source project management that works for you, not against you
description: kaneo is an open source project management tool that aims to work for you rather than against you. It combines issue tracking, a kanban board, and project planning in a single self-hostable package, positioning itself as a Jira and Linear alternative. Built with TypeScript, Hono, and React, it targets teams that want focused project management without heavyweight enterprise processes.
highlights: All-in-one issue tracking, kanban, and planning
Modern TypeScript stack with Hono and React
curatorNote: The self-hosted PM space has been waiting for a genuinely modern, focused option. kaneo's 'works for you, not against you' framing plus a clean stack explains its rapid rise.
